info.title: Freya Bank voice services: statement and debt (test environment mock)
info.description: Seven POST services under /voice/v1/. Request {data, call}; response {data, result}; success = HTTP 200 and result.returnCode '1'. Error answers carry result only. Dates dd.MM.yyyy strings, amounts JSON numbers. The test environment does not check tokens, headers, call or aiFlow.

post.summary: Cards of the customer the assistant may talk about
post.description: Only active cards (status A) come back. Two cards can share productName and cardNumberLast4. productName is free text and may be empty.

schema.description: Contract envelope: service fields under data, call metadata under call

customerNo.description: Customer number the phone menu passes with the call; string or number both accepted

aiFlow.description: Use case asking; 'CardOps' for this flow

call.description: Call metadata the bank logs; not checked in the test environment

cardNumber.description: Masked card number (first six and last four visible); send this value unchanged to the card-level services

productName.description: Card product name as the card system returns it; may be an empty string

isMainCard.description: false for a card that is not the customer's own main card (supplementary); it is still listed

result.description: Result envelope, present on every answer. Success = HTTP 200 and returnCode '1'.

returnCode.description: '1' on success; otherwise an error code (INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR, FB_IVR_CHANNEL_1xx, FBE00099)

messageText.description: Log message, not for the caller

post.summary: Statement and due dates and the debt per currency of one card
post.description: Debt blocks debtTL, debtUSD, debtEUR, debtGBP; any block can be missing.

schema.description: Contract envelope: service fields under data, call metadata under call

cardNumber.description: cardNumber exactly as cards.list returned it (masked in the test environment, e.g. 540000******1234); never rebuilt from digits the caller says

call.description: Call metadata the bank logs; not checked in the test environment

cardNumber.description: Masked differently from cards.list (first 4 + last 4); do not use it for matching

statementDate.description: Date of the last issued statement, format dd.MM.yyyy (e.g. 05.11.2026)

lastPayDate.description: Due date of the last issued statement, format dd.MM.yyyy (e.g. 05.11.2026)

debtTL.description: Debt block for Türk Lirası (TL). The block can be MISSING for a card without this currency; a missing block is not NO_DEBT.

statementPaymentStatus.description: HAS_DEBT or NO_DEBT for the statement debt in this currency

transferAmount.description: Amount carried over from the previous period

remainingDebt.description: What is left of the statement debt after payments since the statement; 0 when fully paid

remainingMinPayment.description: What is left of the minimum payment after payments since the statement; 0 when the minimum was paid

totalDebt.description: Total debt including spending after the statement; negative = credit balance

totalDebtPaymentStatus.description: HAS_DEBT or NO_DEBT for the total debt

remainAutomaticPaymentAmount.description: Remaining automatic payment amount; only meaningful when automaticPaymentFlag is Y

debtUSD.description: Debt block for Dolar (USD). The block can be MISSING for a card without this currency; a missing block is not NO_DEBT.

statementPaymentStatus.description: HAS_DEBT or NO_DEBT for the statement debt in this currency

statementPaymentStatus.description: HAS_DEBT or NO_DEBT for the statement debt in this currency

transferAmount.description: Amount carried over from the previous period

remainingDebt.description: What is left of the statement debt after payments since the statement; 0 when fully paid

remainingMinPayment.description: What is left of the minimum payment after payments since the statement; 0 when the minimum was paid

totalDebt.description: Total debt including spending after the statement; negative = credit balance

totalDebtPaymentStatus.description: HAS_DEBT or NO_DEBT for the total debt

remainAutomaticPaymentAmount.description: Remaining automatic payment amount; only meaningful when automaticPaymentFlag is Y

debtGBP.description: Debt block for İngiliz Sterlini (GBP). The block can be MISSING for a card without this currency; a missing block is not NO_DEBT.

post.summary: Current statement week and day of a card, joint statement info
post.description: relationType is '' for a card with its own statement, 'M' when this is the main card of a pair sharing one statement, 'C' when this card is linked to a main card. Changing the week on either card moves both.

statementDay.description: Current statement day of the month

relationType.description: '' (own statement), 'M' (main card of a shared statement) or 'C' (card linked to a main card)

relatedCardNumber.description: Masked number of the other card of the pair; '' otherwise

relatedCardProductName.description: Product name of the other card of the pair; '' otherwise

post.summary: Preview the dates the card would get with the requested week; changes nothing
post.description: Do not call it for the week the card already has (error). Call before statement.week.change and read the preview dates to the caller.
